# Voters Pull Back From Trump And 2028 Front-Runners As Midterm Deficit Holds

Tampa Free Press
President Donald J. Trump (White House)

President Donald Trump’s job approval rating sits 13 points underwater, with 43% of voters approving of his performance and 55% disapproving, according to the latest tracking survey from Morning Consult. The numbers match record lows recorded earlier this summer.
